answer_1.quote: Sentence simplification is the task of rewriting text to make it easier to read, while preserving its main meaning and important information.

answer_2.quote: We use the SARI metric to measure the simplicity of the generated sentences. SARI computes the arithmetic mean of the n-gram F1 scores of three rewrite operations: adding, deleting, and keeping.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation on the Newsela dataset since automated metrics may be insufficient for evaluating text generation. We chose 30 sentences from the test set for annotation and considered a subset of baselines.
answer_4.guideline: We followed the evaluation setup in , and measure the adequacy (How much meaning from the original sentence is preserved?), simplicity (Is the output simpler than the original sentence?), and fluency (Is the output grammatical?) on a five-point Likert scale.
